objective: Audit User Questions correctness, state machines, async races, resource cleanup, architecture, maintainability, duplication, and performance.
purpose: Find evidence-backed functional and structural defects across the canonical implementation.
routeReason: The coupled renderer, MCP, broker, persistence, and policy state machines need an independent high-context implementation review with a moderate source/test oracle.
ownershipBoundary: Read-only correctness, architecture, maintainability, and performance review of canonical User Questions code and direct callers; no security ownership, edits, or final acceptance.

idealRoute.rationale: Independent review of coupled stateful implementation with substantial context.

evidence: 2026-08-12 universal-role doctor reported schema 3, 18 semantic roles, 16 route profiles, and zero drift.

forbidden: Repository source, generated output, Git state, installed configuration, processes, provider state, and other reviewer/report paths
liveWriters: /root writes only advisor-plans recon, assignment records, and final report; children must not write.

assumptions: Canonical tweak source is tweaks/user-questions; catalog and installer runtime assets are synchronized derivatives.
The task is a read-only audit; source, generated output, installed state, configuration, processes, Git state, and external services must not be mutated.
The parent owns vetting, severity calibration, final acceptance, and final synthesis.

manualChecks.check: Return findings only, each with severity, category, exact current file:line evidence, impact, effort, fix risk, confidence, and fix sketch; include by-design/rejected candidates.
manualChecks.expectedResult: A complete read-only evidence report with no files changed.

constraints.branchWorktreeAuthority: No branch, worktree, staging, commit, push, tag, stash, reset, or Git mutation authority.
constraints.scopeBoundary: Read-only audit of the explicitly assigned User Questions surfaces and direct evidence only.
constraints.destructiveActionBoundary: No edits, installs, builds, formatters, synchronization writes, policy changes, app control, restart, promotion, credential reads, or external writes.

stopConditions: A conclusion requires changing repository, installed, live, provider, or user configuration state.
Evidence falls outside the assigned dimension or the target has drifted.
The exact assigned route is unavailable.
A potential secret is encountered; report only credential type and file location without reproducing the value.

escalationPolicy.diagnosisFirst: Return the evidence gap and safest read-only next check; do not broaden authority or substitute route.
